Company

Overview Ownership & Structure

InsightsPod will be registered as a limited-liability corporation. Zubair Khan will own 90% shares and 10% will be owned by Anya Rasulova. No outside investors are involved at this point in time.

Team

The executive team at InsightsPod has two members - Zubair Khan and Anya Rasulova.
Zubair will manage the day-to-day operations and company strategy, whereas Anya will be the strategic advisor and overlooking product enhancement.
